entities.name: miR-361-5p
observations: Positive tumor-tissue staining occurred in 295 of 375 breast-cancer patients and was associated with longer disease-free survival: median 95.52 versus 82.33 months, P=0.002; the association was strongest in triple-negative breast cancer, P=0.004. Authors described it as an independent predictive factor, but adjusted HR, CI, and covariates were not available in the retrieved report.

Higher expression was positively correlated with improved survival in a separate TCGA breast-tumor analysis, but breast-cancer-specific HR, CI, and conventional multivariable details were unavailable.
A 2021 TCGA-based study found no significant association with overall survival, indicating inconsistent OS evidence.
Retrieved breast-cancer prognostic evidence concerns tumor tissue or TCGA tumor expression; no direct circulating miR-361-5p prognostic evidence was identified.

entities.name: Breast cancer
observations: Direct clinical evidence indicates a favorable association between positive/high tumor miR-361-5p expression and disease-free survival, but overall-survival evidence is not consistent. Specific associations with stage, lymph-node metastasis, distant metastasis, or relapse were not established.
